items.title: 智寶首度進軍好萊塢 《電鋸甜心》啟動真人版電影計畫
items.title_en: ZhiBao Enters Hollywood for the First Time, Launches Live‑Action Film Project for "Lollipop Chainsaw"
paras: 動漫遊戲(ACG)IP公司智寶(7824-TW)擴大全球 IP 計畫，繼正式公開《電鋸甜心2》遊戲開發計畫後，接力宣布將推進《LollipopChainsaw 電鋸甜心》真人版電影及動畫拍攝計畫，也是公司IP首度進軍好萊塢。
智寶總經理鄧橋表示，《電鋸甜心》具備成為經典娛樂品牌的所有要素，因此透過與跨國夥伴們合作，製作出世界級的遊戲、動畫與真人影視作品。其中，《電鋸甜心》真人版電影將為延續原作世界觀的全新原創故事，時間軸設定於原作遊戲事件之前，目前選角大致底定，明年開始拍攝及動畫後製，智寶最快明年可開始認列授權金，後續上映後則可認列票房分潤。

鄧橋進一步指出，《電鋸甜心》全球 IP 計畫已正式進入跨國團隊協作與跨載體同步推進的階段，主要參與方包括IP 原作版權DRAGAMI GAMES、IP 計畫統籌智寶、遊戲製作JP UNIVERSE、影視開發Ambitious Entertainment/Non Stop Studios/Orange Chariot/Throne、策略投資包括台灣大哥大(3045-TW)、威剛(3260-TW)、影一製作所等。
《電鋸甜心》首部真人版電影由智寶主動發起，集結好萊塢規格的歐美電影製作團隊，由5位製作人共同操刀，除了鄧橋外，還有Throne執行長結城崇史、Orange Chariot 共同創辦人Robert Franke、Ambitious Entertainment 執行長 Kirk Shaw，以及 Non Stop Studios Corp. 總裁Patricio Rabuffetti。

團隊陣容具備了豐沛的國際影視製作實績，Kirk Shaw 為好萊塢最具產量與實績的製作人之一，累計操刀 250 部以上電影與7部電視影集，曾任奧斯卡金像獎得獎作品《危機倒數》（The Hurt Locker）副製作人；Patricio Rabuffetti 所帶領的 Non Stop 擁有逾25年經驗、整合歐美20家以上公司的影音價值鏈網絡；Robert Franke 曾操刀與富士電視台、HuluJapan 共製合作影集。
paras_en: Animation‑game (ACG) IP company ZhiBao (7824‑TW) is expanding its global IP program. After officially announcing the development of the "Lollipop Chainsaw 2" game, the company now reveals plans to advance a live‑action film and animation production for "Lollipop Chainsaw," marking its first foray into Hollywood for the IP.

General manager Deng Qiao said that "Lollipop Chainsaw" has all the ingredients to become a classic entertainment brand, and through cooperation with multinational partners it will be turned into world‑class games, animation and live‑action audiovisual works. The live‑action film will tell an original story that continues the original universe but is set before the events of the game. Casting is largely settled, filming and animation post‑production will begin next year, and ZhiBao could start recognizing licensing fees as early as next year, with box‑office revenue sharing to be recorded after the film’s release.

Deng further noted that the global IP plan for "Lollipop Chainsaw" has entered a stage of cross‑border team collaboration and multi‑platform simultaneous development. Key participants include the IP original rights holder DRAGAMI GAMES, ZhiBao as the IP project coordinator, game developer JP UNIVERSE, film‑TV developers Ambitious Entertainment, Non Stop Studios and Orange Chariot, as well as strategic investors such as Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW), ADATA (3260‑TW) and Ying‑One Production.

The first live‑action movie for "Lollipop Chainsaw" is being initiated by ZhiBao, assembling a Hollywood‑standard European‑American production team. Five producers are steering the project: besides Deng Qiao, there are Throne CEO Takashi Yuki, Orange Chariot co‑founder Robert Franke, Ambitious Entertainment CEO Kirk Shaw, and Non Stop Studios Corp. President Patricio Rabuffetti.

The team brings extensive international film‑production credentials. Kirk Shaw is one of Hollywood’s most prolific producers, having overseen more than 250 films and seven TV series and serving as associate producer on the Oscar‑winning "The Hurt Locker." Patricio Rabuffetti’s Non Stop Studios boasts over 25 years of experience and a media‑value‑chain network that integrates more than 20 European and American companies. Robert Franke has produced co‑productions with Fuji TV and Hulu Japan.

items.title: 志聖慶一甲子家庭日逾800人同歡　加發4000萬元獎金感謝同仁
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng Celebrates 60th Anniversary Family Day with Over 800 Participants, Grants Additional NT$40 Million Bonus to Thank Employees
paras: 台積電(2467-TW)供應鏈志聖工業(2467-TW)今(19)日舉辦60周年家庭日盛事，林口、台中廠員工與眷屬逾800人齊聚桃園六福村，共同歡慶一甲子里程碑。董事長梁茂生、梁又文現場宣布，公司將加發總額4000萬元獎金，感謝全體同仁今年的努力，也感謝家人長期在背後支持。
志聖董事長梁茂生、總經理梁又文指出，志聖走過60年，最珍貴的力量始終來自「人」，每一項成果都有同仁的投入，也有家人在背後一路相伴。
PCB及半導體設備廠的志聖，力在今天晚間的「點亮60」星光音樂會中特別播放以《禮運大同篇》為歌詞重新演繹的志聖60週年《孔子之歌》，傳遞文化傳承與人本價值；孫淑媚、魏如昀、李聖傑也接力演出，與同仁及家屬共享60周年的喜悅。
志聖026年1-8月營收70.77億元，已經超越2025年全年，年增83.37%。志聖 2026 上半年營收 50.44 億元，較去年同期成長 78.92%；歸屬母公司業主稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元。
paras_en: TSMC (2467‑TW) supply‑chain partner Zhi Sheng Industrial (2467‑TW) held a grand 60th‑anniversary family day today (19th), bringing together more than 800 employees and their families from the Linkou and Taichung plants at Taoyuan’s Leofoo Village to celebrate the six‑decade milestone. Chairmen Liang Maosheng and Liang Youwen announced on site that the company will issue an additional total bonus of NT$40 million to thank all staff for their efforts this year and to appreciate families for their long‑standing support behind the scenes.

Chairman Liang Maosheng and General Manager Liang Youwen noted that after 60 years, Zhi Sheng’s most valuable strength has always come from “people”; every achievement reflects the dedication of employees and the continuous support of their families.

At tonight’s “Light Up 60” star‑filled concert, Zhi Sheng— a PCB and semiconductor equipment manufacturer— specially performed a re‑interpreted “Confucius Song” for its 60th anniversary, using lyrics from the “Li Yun Da Tong” piece to convey cultural heritage and human‑centric values. Performers Sun Shumei, Wei Ruyun and Li Shengjie also took the stage, sharing the joy of the 60th anniversary with colleagues and their families.

Zhi Sheng’s revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$7.077 billion, already surpassing the full‑year 2025 figure, an 83.37% year‑over‑year increase. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$5.044 billion, up 78.92% from the same period last year; net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$1.106 billion, a 2.09‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share were NT$7.16.

items.title: 〈房產〉永和大陳公辦都更再向前推進 漢皇建設單元7今啟動拆除
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Yonghe Da Chen Public Urban Renewal Project Advances Again, Hanhuang Construction Unit 7 Begins Demolition Today
paras: 新北市政府辦理的「永和新生地（大陳地區）更新單元7公辦都更案」今(19)日上午舉行拆除動工典禮，大陳公辦都更案是全台最大、最複雜困難的公辦都市更新計畫，這也是漢皇繼永和大陳單元6「漢皇River Sky」傳熱銷佳績，今年再度推進永和重大更新進程。
永和大陳地區更新單元7面積約1.34公頃，新北市府自2021年完成招商，由漢皇建設擔任實施者後，團隊積極推動相關作業；本案約歷經2年完成審議核定，進入拆除階段，象徵大陳地區都市更新再向前邁進，此次拆除動工不僅代表更新工程正式啟動，
大陳地區更新單元7案建築設計以環境永續與公共利益為核心，規劃黃金級綠建築、黃金級智慧建築、無障礙環境設計及耐震標章，並提供市民活動中心及社會住宅，打造永和地區嶄新的宜居環境，預計於2031年讓住戶入住新居。而漢皇建設可售總銷達255億元，規劃爲2-4房格局。
漢皇單元7的都更面積含道路用地面積3805坪，扣除道路面積3793坪。若連同單元六「漢皇River Sky」，扣除道路面積合計達6960坪。單元7規劃1515戶，三棟規劃地上36樓，地下6層。
漢皇集團後續預計推案則包括，頂溪門戶計畫、懷生段、三興段、塭仔圳、光復街東側、秀北段、水源段、南山段等個案，總銷預計突破1000億元。
paras_en: The New Taipei City Government’s "Yonghe New Life (Da Chen Area) Urban Renewal Unit 7 Public Project" held a demolition groundbreaking ceremony this morning (19th). The Da Chen public urban renewal project is the largest and most complex public urban renewal plan in Taiwan, and this marks Hanhuang’s continued push on the major Yonghe renewal process after the strong sales performance of Unit 6 "Hanhuang River Sky".

Unit 7 of the Yonghe Da Chen area covers about 1.34 hectares. After the city completed the investment solicitation in 2021 and appointed Hanhuang Construction as the implementer, the team has been actively advancing related work. The case took roughly two years to complete review and approval and has now entered the demolition phase, symbolizing another step forward for Da Chen’s urban renewal. This demolition start not only signals the official launch of the renewal works,

The architectural design of Unit 7 in the Da Chen area centers on environmental sustainability and public interest, planning gold‑standard green buildings, gold‑standard smart buildings, barrier‑free environments, and seismic‑resistance certification. It will also provide a community activity center and social housing to create a brand‑new livable environment in Yonghe, with residents expected to move into new homes by 2031. Hanhuang Construction’s total sales potential for the project reaches NT$25.5 billion, featuring 2‑ to 4‑room layouts.

Hanhuang’s Unit 7 renewal area includes 3,805 ping of road land, with 3,793 ping of road area deducted. When combined with Unit 6 "Hanhuang River Sky", the total road‑deducted area reaches 6,960 ping. Unit 7 plans for 1,515 households, with three buildings each rising 36 floors above ground and six basement levels.

Hanhuang Group’s subsequent projects are expected to include the Dingxi Gateway Project, Huaisheng Section, Sanxing Section, Wenzai Canal, East Side of Guangfu Street, Xiubei Section, Water Source Section, and Nanshan Section, with total sales projected to exceed NT$100 billion.

items.title: 美光勞資談判觸及三議題 10/22再舉行第二次會議
items.title_en: Micron Labor Negotiations Cover Three Issues; Second Meeting Scheduled for Oct. 22
paras: 美光(MU-US)台灣與台灣美光記憶體工會於昨日舉行首次調解會議，美光今(19)日表示，雙方進行有建設性且助於推進溝通的討論，並同意於 10 月 22 日舉行第二次調解會議。雙方感謝中部科學園區管理局(CTSP)及調解委員會在本次調解過程中所提供的協助與支持。
美光勞資雙方在此次會議中，就多項議題進行討論，包括整體獎酬與獎金制度架構、禁搭便車(No Free Rider)議題，以及禁止秋後算賬(Non-Retaliation)等。
有關最後一項，美光再次重申公司的承諾，正如《美光全球團隊成員手冊》中所載明，團隊成員有權在不必擔心遭受報復的情況下，和平集會、自由結社、成立及加入其自行選擇的工會或勞工組織，並尋求集體協商或其他形式的代表權。
雙方將持續秉持相互尊重的精神，透過正向、務實的溝通，支持員工、服務客戶，並共同促進公司的持續成功。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) and the Taiwan Micron Memory Workers Union held their first mediation meeting in Taiwan yesterday. Micron announced on the 19th that the discussion was constructive and helped advance communication, and both parties agreed to hold a second mediation meeting on October 22. The parties thanked the Central Taiwan Science Park Administration (CTSP) and the mediation committee for their assistance and support during the process.
During the meeting, Micron and the union discussed several matters, including the overall compensation and bonus structure, the No Free Rider issue, and the prohibition of non‑retaliation practices.

Regarding the last item, Micron reiterated its commitment, as stated in the Micron Global Team Member Handbook, that team members have the right to peacefully assemble, freely associate, form and join unions or labor organizations of their choosing, and seek collective bargaining or other forms of representation without fear of retaliation.

Both sides will continue to uphold a spirit of mutual respect, engage in positive and pragmatic communication, support employees and serve customers, and jointly promote the company’s ongoing success.

items.title: AI四巨頭遭起訴！Anthropic「AI放緩論」涉非法商業合謀、違反美國反壟斷法？
items.title_en: Four AI Giants Sued! Anthropic's "AI Slowdown Theory" Involved in Illegal Commercial Conspiracy, Violating US Antitrust Law?
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業的監管爭議正從政策討論延伸至法律層面。據報，4名原告近日在加州聯邦法院提起民事訴訟，指控Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI及Google(GOOGL-US) 涉嫌違反美國反壟斷法，透過公開協調放緩AI發展速度，構成非法商業合謀。
根據《POLITICO》報導，這起訴訟的導火線，是Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）本月稍早發表的一篇文章。
他在文中呼籲AI產業「協調行動」，以「控制AI尖端技術的發展步調」。這項主張隨後獲得xAI負責人馬斯克、OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及Google DeepMind共同創辦人哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）公開附議。
原告認為，相關公開表態已構成競爭對手之間的非法商業協議。案件若進入實質審理階段，可能牽動AI產業的競爭格局及監管方向。
這起訴訟是在加州北區聯邦地方法院提出。原告代理律師之一Nick Rowley在聲明中表示，提告目的是防止「全球最具影響力的營利科技公司之間，基於自身利益達成的私下協議」，導致AI「迅速脫離人類控制」。
Rowley指出，面對核戰爭等可能威脅人類存續的風險，人類應獲得明確且可靠的保障；相關法律規範則應由政府透過透明、合法且對公眾負責的程序建立。
原告的法律主張在於，即使相關表態是以公共安全為出發點，但阿莫戴的公開倡議，以及其他AI產業領袖的回應，可能構成競爭對手就商業行為達成協議，進而觸及美國反壟斷法規範。
這起訴訟的背景，是AI安全議題持續引發討論。近期包括現任及前任AI研究人員均發出警告，認為如果缺乏充分的安全防護措施，AI技術持續發展可能對人類生存構成重大威脅。
相關產業領袖提出放緩AI尖端技術發展的主張，正是在這一背景下出現。
不過，這起訴訟將原本聚焦於AI安全的討論，轉化為反壟斷法律爭議。原告並非否定AI可能帶來的安全風險，而是主張，無論企業出於何種動機，競爭對手之間的協調行為都不應免於法律監督。
原告並在訴狀中強調，涉及AI發展速度及安全規範的決策，應透過政府透明的制度與程序推動，而不應由企業私下協調主導。
4名原告的背景各不相同。其中，律師Cheyenne Hunt過去曾參與揭露前加州聯邦眾議員Eric Swalwell及前緬因州參議員候選人Graham Platner涉及性行為不當的指控。
另外兩名原告為佛羅里達州律師Charles Buist及Nick Spetsas，第4名原告則是加州居民Christine Bullock。
訴訟文件顯示，原告有意將案件擴大為集體訴訟，代表所有受到相關企業放緩AI發展決策影響的群體。若此一訴求獲准，案件涉及的潛在索賠範圍可能擴大。
paras_en: Regulatory disputes in the AI industry are moving from policy discussions to the legal arena. According to reports, four plaintiffs recently filed a civil lawsuit in a federal court in California, accusing Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and Google (GOOGL-US) of violating US antitrust law by publicly coordinating to slow the pace of AI development, constituting illegal commercial collusion.
According to POLITICO, the spark for the lawsuit was an article published earlier this month by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.

In the piece he called for the AI industry to "coordinate actions" to "control the pace of development of cutting‑edge AI technology." The proposal was subsequently publicly endorsed by xAI head Elon Musk, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and DeepMind co‑founder Demis Hassabis.

The plaintiffs argue that the public statements amount to an illegal commercial agreement among competitors. If the case proceeds to trial, it could affect the competitive landscape and regulatory direction of the AI sector.

The suit was filed in the Northern District of California federal court. One of the plaintiffs' attorneys, Nick Rowley, said in a statement that the purpose of the filing is to prevent "private agreements between the world’s most influential for‑profit tech companies, based on their own interests," that could cause AI to "rapidly get out of human control."

Rowley noted that faced with existential risks such as nuclear war, humanity must have clear and reliable safeguards; related legal rules should be established by the government through transparent, lawful, and publicly accountable procedures.

The plaintiffs’ legal claim is that even if the statements are framed as public‑safety concerns, Amodei’s public advocacy and the responses of other AI leaders may constitute an agreement among competitors on business conduct, thereby violating US antitrust statutes.

The lawsuit comes against a backdrop of ongoing debate over AI safety. Recently, both current and former AI researchers have warned that without adequate safety measures, continued AI development could pose a major threat to human survival.
Industry leaders’ calls to slow the development of cutting‑edge AI technologies have emerged in this context.

However, the lawsuit reframes the discussion that was originally focused on AI safety into an antitrust dispute. The plaintiffs do not deny the potential safety risks of AI, but argue that regardless of corporate motives, coordinated behavior among competitors should not be exempt from legal oversight.
The complaint emphasizes that decisions about AI development speed and safety standards should be driven through transparent government processes, not by private corporate coordination.

The four plaintiffs have diverse backgrounds. Among them, attorney Cheyenne Hunt previously helped expose allegations of sexual misconduct involving former California federal Representative Eric Swalwell and former Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner.
The other two plaintiffs are Florida attorneys Charles Buist and Nick Spetsas, and the fourth plaintiff is California resident Christine Bullock.

Court documents show the plaintiffs intend to expand the case into a class action representing all groups affected by the companies’ decisions to slow AI development. If that request is granted, the potential scope of claims could broaden significantly.

items.title: 科技巨頭尋找台積電替代方案！Piper Sandler：英特爾14A獲亞馬遜、蘋果、Google等公司評估
items.title_en: Tech Giants Seek TSMC Alternatives! Piper Sandler: Intel's 14A Under Evaluation by Amazon, Apple, Google and Others
paras: 儘管英特爾(INTC-US) 下一代14A製程目前尚未確定主要客戶，但根據Piper Sandler最新發布的投資報告，隨著業界積極尋找台積電(2330-TW) 以外的可行替代方案，科技業各大企業均已開始評估這項製程。
根據《Wccftech》報導，Piper Sandler指出，在多項宏觀與微觀因素交互影響下，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、蘋果（Apple）、超微半導體(AMD-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 、特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 及高通(QCOM-US) 都在評估這項下一代製程。
Piper Sandler在報告中對英特爾14A製程抱持相對正面的看法，並指出其技術數據的改善幅度優於預期。
根據相關進展，14A製程的缺陷密度（D0）已於2026年6月降至0.5。英特爾的目標是在2027年第一季前，進一步將D0降至0.1至0.2。
缺陷密度是指每單位矽晶圓面積中，平均檢測到的微小瑕疵或缺陷數量。當晶片製程逐漸接近商業化階段，缺陷密度通常會明顯下降，並帶動晶片良率提升。
英特爾財務長David Zinsner近日也指出，14A製程的改善速度至少是自2012年22奈米製程時代以來最快的一次。
在台積電產能至少要到2028年以前都可能持續吃緊的情況下，半導體業者正積極尋找替代方案，以消化未能及時滿足的訂單需求。
目前，可供選擇的主要對象包括三星電子(005930KS) 與英特爾。
此外，川普政府持續施壓、要求晶片製造業者將產能移回美國，也讓英特爾成為潛在的替代選項之一。不過，這仍取決於14A製程能否達到市場預期。
英特爾8月透過發行新股籌集約150億美元資金，之後又將規模提高至200億美元。儘管公司當時並未明確說明這筆新資金的具體用途，但表示，此次發行旨在協助英特爾掌握未來成長機會，同時維持穩健的資產負債表及投資級信用評等。
不過，英特爾執行長陳立武（Lip-Bu Tan）已多次表示，只有在14A這項最尖端製程取得確定訂單、鎖定主要客戶後，才會批准晶圓代工業務大幅擴張。
這也成為目前觀察14A製程商業化可行性最明確的線索之一。尤其英特爾目前已持有約300億美元現金，似乎沒有必要為一般性用途額外籌資。
此外，隨著英特爾第62座晶圓廠（Fab 62）的廠房主體接近完工，公司預計還需要約100億美元設備建置資金，才能啟用14A製程的新產能，每月約可生產2萬片晶圓。因此，英特爾近期的籌資規模，足以支應即將到來的資本支出需求。
英特爾14A屬於1.4奈米級製程，主要技術特色包括：

PowerDirect背面供電技術： 將電力傳輸線路全面移至矽晶圓背面，釋放正面佈線空間供資料訊號使用，藉此降低電阻並提高電晶體密度。
RibbonFET 2電晶體與第二代環繞式閘極（GAA）架構： 強化對微型電晶體的靜電控制能力，提升驅動電流，同時將功率洩漏降至最低。


英特爾本週再次確認，預計於2027年第二季啟動14A製程的風險試產，並在2028年第一季進入量產階段。
paras_en: Despite Intel (INTC-US) not yet confirming its main customers for the next‑generation 14A process, Piper Sandler’s latest investment report says that as the industry actively looks for viable alternatives to TSMC (2330‑TW), major tech firms have begun evaluating the node.

According to Wccftech, Piper Sandler notes that, amid a mix of macro and micro factors, Amazon (AMZN‑US), Apple, AMD (AMD‑US), Google (GOOGL‑US), Tesla (TSLA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) are all assessing the next‑gen process.
Piper Sandler takes a relatively positive view of Intel’s 14A process in its report, pointing out that the improvement in its technical metrics exceeds expectations.
Based on recent progress, the defect density (D0) of the 14A process fell to 0.5 in June 2026. Intel aims to further reduce D0 to between 0.1 and 0.2 before the first quarter of 2027.

Defect density refers to the average number of tiny flaws detected per unit area of a silicon wafer. As a chip process approaches commercialization, defect density typically drops sharply, driving up wafer yields.
Intel CFO David Zinsner recently said the pace of improvement for 14A is the fastest since the 22‑nm era in 2012.
With TSMC capacity likely to remain tight at least through 2028, semiconductor companies are actively seeking alternatives to absorb unmet order demand.
The primary alternatives currently under consideration are Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and Intel itself.

In addition, pressure from the Trump administration to bring chip manufacturing capacity back to the United States has made Intel a potential substitute, though this still hinges on 14A meeting market expectations.

In August, Intel raised roughly $15 billion through a new share offering, later increasing the target to $20 billion. While the company did not specify the exact use of the proceeds, it said the issuance was intended to help Intel capture future growth opportunities while maintaining a strong balance sheet and investment‑grade credit rating.
However, CEO Lip‑Bu Tan has repeatedly said that only after the 14A node secures firm orders and key customers will Intel approve a major expansion of its foundry business.

This is one of the clearest clues currently available for assessing the commercial viability of 14A. Intel already holds about $30 billion in cash, suggesting there is little need to raise additional funds for generic purposes.

Furthermore, with Fab 62 nearing completion, Intel estimates it will need roughly $10 billion in equipment spending to bring 14A capacity online, which would produce about 20,000 wafers per month. Recent fundraising should comfortably cover this upcoming capex.
Intel’s 14A is a 1.4‑nm class process featuring several key technologies:

PowerDirect backside power delivery moves all power routing to the back of the wafer, freeing front‑side routing for data signals, reducing resistance and increasing transistor density. RibbonFET 2 transistors combined with second‑generation gate‑all‑around (GAA) architecture enhance electrostatic control of tiny transistors, boost drive current and minimize power leakage.

items.title: 巴菲特卸任波克夏董座 留下5個領導哲學：想好訃聞、別死後還想掌權
items.title_en: Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Chairman, Leaves 5 Leadership Philosophies: Think About Your Obituary, Don’t Want to Rule After Death
paras: 想要成為像巴菲特這樣成就非凡的領袖，保持謙遜至關重要。這位「奧馬哈先知」上周卸下了波克夏(A)(BRK.A-US) 董事長的職務，結束了他超過半個世紀打造並經營這家企業集團的生涯。巴菲特表示，他的兒子霍華將接任董事長。
霍華將負責守護波克夏的企業文化與價值觀。巴菲特先前曾表示，這些無形資產「比我們資產負債表上的任何東西都更有價值」。
對於像巴菲特這樣深信組織文化重要性的人而言，這並非新鮮事。多年來，他在投資與領導統御方面持續提供了源源不絕的真知灼見。
去年，在他以執行長身分發給股東的最後一封感恩節信函中，他分享了關於奉獻、誠信，以及他所謂在試圖抑制執行長高薪時卻適得其反的「好意」等美德見解。
其中一個宏觀的核心收穫，便是他呼籲眾人持續學習與成長。
巴菲特寫道：「慎選你心目中的英雄，然後向他們學習。你永遠不會完美，但永遠可以變得更好。」
以下是巴菲特分享的其他五項經營與人生哲學：
保持謙遜
現年96歲的巴菲特向來以務實、不講排場的作風經營波克夏。他曾談到，運氣在自己的人生與事業中扮演重要角色，而這些經歷也不斷加深他的謙遜態度。
巴菲特表示：「要記住，清潔人員和董事長一樣，都是有血有肉的人。」
他也將自己的成就部分歸因於先天條件與幸運。相較於他的姊妹們，他形容她們「擁有同等聰明的頭腦與更好的性格」，儘管她們面臨截然不同的社會前景。
他說：「我1930年出生，身體健康、智力還算不錯，是白人、男性，而且出生在美國。哇！感謝幸運女神眷顧。」
從錯誤中學習
巴菲特表示，儘管自己犯過無數錯誤，但他始終試圖將其轉化為成長的跳板。「從中學到至少一點教訓，然後繼續前進。」
他指出，其中一個失誤是當他發現某家母公司或子公司一位「優秀且忠誠的執行長」出現「罹患失智症、阿茲海默症或其他長期失能疾病」的徵兆時，自己沒有更強勢地介入。
「查理和我曾多次遇到這個問題，卻未能採取行動。這種不作為可能會釀成巨大錯誤，」巴菲特寫道，他所指的是他結交多年、已於2023年逝世的摯友兼事業夥伴查理蒙格。
巴菲特表示，儘管這通常並非易事，但董事會必須密切留意高階主管是否出現此類病徵，執行長本身也需要在其管轄的單位內做到這一點。
「董事們應提高警覺並勇於發聲，這是我唯一的忠告，」這封約莫7頁長的信件中如此寫道。
選對領導人
巴菲特對謙遜的要求，也延伸至波克夏未來領導人的行事方式及追求目標。
他認為，未來100年內，波克夏只需要更換5至6位執行長。在上周五發布的致股東信中，巴菲特再次表達對接任執行長的阿貝爾充滿信心。
巴菲特寫道：「他早已開始負責真正重要的決策，而他的任何決定都未曾讓我產生疑慮。」
波克夏原本是新英格蘭地區的一家紡織公司，巴菲特自1960年代初期開始買進該公司股票。他去年秋天曾表示，波克夏應避免聘用動機不純的高階主管。
巴菲特說：「公司尤其應避開那些一心想在65歲退休、追求炫耀式財富，或企圖建立家族王朝的人。」
思考你的訃聞
巴菲特在信中反覆強調一項觀念：「想要變得更好，永遠不嫌晚。」
他的另一項建議是，先想像自己希望訃聞如何描述一生，再反向思考，「活出一段配得上那篇訃聞的人生」。
由於巴菲特身為全球最著名投資人之一的地位，他向波克夏股東發布第三封年度感恩節信函已然成了一大盛事。他當時表示，未來仍計畫透過年度信件與股東對話，儘管不再以執行長身分。「用英國人的話來說，我要『安靜退場』了。算是吧。」
不要在身後繼續掌權
巴菲特決定轉任名譽董事長，也符合他不應過度延續個人影響力的主張。
在感恩節致股東信中，巴菲特稱讚阿貝爾的能力。阿貝爾比他年輕約30歲，並已於2026年初接任波克夏執行長。
巴菲特表示：「他是一位卓越的經理人、不知疲倦的工作狂，也是一位誠懇的溝通者。」
他同時也提及自己的三個孩子，表示他們具備妥善分配家族龐大財富所需的「成熟度、智慧、精力和直覺」。今年稍早，巴菲特的淨資產已逼近1500億美元。
巴菲特去年曾寫道，在他過世後，他的孩子們將能自由應對稅法政策及其他變數的變化，以持續推動家族的慈善事業。
他說：「歷來試圖死後掌權的人，結果往往不理想，而我從來沒有這樣的念頭。」
paras_en: To become a leader as extraordinary as Warren Buffett, humility is essential. The “Oracle of Omaha” stepped down last week from his role as chairman of Berkshire (A)(BRK.A-US), ending a career of more than half a century building and running the conglomerate. Buffett said his son Howard will succeed him as chairman.
Howard will be responsible for safeguarding Berkshire’s corporate culture and values. Buffett has previously said that these intangible assets “are worth more than anything on our balance sheet.”

For someone like Buffett, who deeply believes in the importance of organizational culture, this is not new. Over the years he has continuously offered a steady stream of insight on investing and leadership.

In his final Thanksgiving letter to shareholders as CEO last year, he shared his thoughts on virtues such as dedication, integrity, and the “good intentions” that backfire when trying to curb excessive CEO pay.
One of the overarching takeaways was his call for everyone to keep learning and growing.
Buffett wrote, “Choose your heroes wisely, then learn from them. You’ll never be perfect, but you can always get better.”
Below are the other five business and life philosophies Buffett shared:
Stay Humble
Now 96, Buffett has always run Berkshire in a pragmatic, no‑frills manner. He has spoken about how luck has played a major role in his life and career, deepening his humility over time.
Buffett said, “Remember, the janitor is just as much a human being as the chairman.”

He also attributes part of his success to innate traits and luck. Compared with his sisters, he described them as “equally smart but with better personalities,” even though they faced very different social prospects.
He said, “I was born in 1930, I’m healthy, reasonably intelligent, white, male, and born in the United States. Wow! Thank you, Lady Luck.”
Learn From Mistakes
Buffett noted that although he has made countless mistakes, he always tries to turn them into stepping stones for growth. “Learn at least one lesson from each, then move on.”
He pointed out that one error was failing to intervene more forcefully when he noticed a “stellar and loyal CEO” showing signs of dementia, Alzheimer’s or other long‑term incapacities.

“Charlie and I have encountered this many times and did nothing. That inaction could lead to a huge mistake,” Buffett wrote, referring to his longtime friend and business partner Charlie Munger, who passed away in 2023.
Buffett said that, while it’s often difficult, boards must closely monitor senior executives for such symptoms, and CEOs themselves need to do the same within their domains.
“Directors should stay alert and speak up—that’s my only advice,” the roughly seven‑page letter said.
Choose the Right Leaders
Buffett’s demand for humility also extends to how Berkshire’s future leaders should act and what they should pursue.
He believes Berkshire will need only five or six CEOs over the next 100 years. In the shareholder letter released last Friday, Buffett again expressed confidence in the incoming CEO, Ajay Babel.
Buffett wrote, “He has already been making the truly important decisions, and I have never doubted any of his choices.”
Berkshire began as a New England textile firm, and Buffett started buying its stock in the early 1960s. He said last fall that Berkshire should avoid hiring senior managers with impure motives.
Buffett said, “The company should especially steer clear of people who only want to retire at 65, chase flashy wealth, or build a family dynasty.”
Think About Your Obituary
Buffett repeatedly emphasized in the letter, “It’s never too late to get better.”
Another piece of advice is to first imagine how you want your obituary to describe your life, then work backward, “live a life worthy of that obituary.”

Because of Buffett’s stature as one of the world’s most famous investors, his third annual Thanksgiving letter to Berkshire shareholders has become a major event. He said he still plans to communicate with shareholders through the annual letter, even though he is no longer CEO. “In British terms, I’m going to ‘quietly exit.’ That’s about it.”
Don’t Keep Power After You’re Gone
Buffett’s decision to become honorary chairman aligns with his belief that he should not extend his personal influence excessively.
In the Thanksgiving letter, Buffett praised Babel’s abilities. Babel is about 30 years younger and took over as Berkshire’s CEO in early 2026.
Buffett said, “He is an outstanding manager, tireless workaholic, and a sincere communicator.”

He also mentioned his three children, saying they possess the “maturity, wisdom, energy and intuition” needed to allocate the family’s vast wealth responsibly. Earlier this year, Buffett’s net worth approached $150 billion.
Buffett wrote last year that after his death his children will be free to adapt to tax‑law changes and other variables, continuing the family’s philanthropic efforts.
He said, “People who try to rule after death usually end poorly, and I’ve never had that thought.”

items.title: SanDisk週一將加入標普100指數！被動買盤會帶動股價上漲嗎？
paras: NAND快閃記憶體製造商SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 將於下週一（21日）正式納入標普100指數（S&P 100），成為美國大型藍籌股代表之一。戴爾科技(DELL-US) 、Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) 及Arista網路(ANET-US) 也將與SanDisk一同加入。
根據《The Motley Fool》報導，隨著SanDisk等四家公司加入，Nike(NKE-US) 、高露潔-棕欖(CL-US) 、賽門物業集團(SPG-US) 及Honeywell Aerospace (HONA-US) 4家公司將退出該指數。
此次成分股調整，也反映今年美股市場的產業與個股表現差異。SanDisk今年股價漲幅超過600%，同期Nike股價則在本週觸及52週低點。
SanDisk目前市值約2,600億美元，超過Nike約540億美元市值的4倍。

納入標普100帶來多少被動買盤？

股票被納入指數後，追蹤該指數的基金通常必須買進相關股票，因此指數成分股調整往往受到投資人關注。不過，SanDisk此次加入標普100所帶來的被動買盤，可能沒有市場想像中龐大。
原因在於，SanDisk早已是標普500指數成分股，追蹤該基準指數的大型基金原本就持有SanDisk股票。
這次新增的潛在買盤，主要來自專門追蹤標普100指數的基金，而這些基金通常會在調整生效前的週五收盤時（即調整生效前）進行交易。
此外，這部分資金規模有限。以貝萊德旗下iShares基金為例，追蹤標普100指數的基金規模約200億美元；相較之下，該公司旗下核心標普500指數基金規模約8,370億美元，且市場上還有其他大型基金追蹤標普500指數。
若SanDisk在標普100指數中的權重約為0.5%，上述iShares基金所需買進的SanDisk股票價值約為1億美元。
對於交易活躍的SanDisk而言，這筆資金規模影響程度相對有限。近期SanDisk單日正常交易量的股票價值超過150億美元，因此指數調整帶來的買盤可能在一天的交易量中便被消化。

SanDisk股價飆升 主因來自業務表現

SanDisk真正跨越更大的指數門檻，是去年11月28日正式納入標普500指數。該公司股價在2025年收於237.38美元，而此後股價累計漲幅超過7倍。不過，分析認為，這波漲勢與指數基金買盤的關聯有限。
SanDisk主要銷售應用於資料中心、手機及筆記型電腦等設備的NAND快閃記憶體。公司截至今年7月3日的2026會計年度表現亮眼，全年營收達202.5億美元，年增175%；其中，資料中心營收大增437%，成為主要成長動力。
SanDisk全年淨利達114億美元，相較前一年度虧損16億美元，獲利表現大幅改善。
單看2026會計年度第4季，SanDisk營收達89.7億美元，年增372%。公司表示，該季營收較前一季的增長，約有三分之二來自價格上漲，而非銷售量增加。

記憶體價格仍是股價後市關鍵

儘管SanDisk的成長動能仍在，但營收增速已開始放緩。公司第3季營收季增97%，第4季季增幅度則降至51%。
管理層對2027會計年度第1季的營收指引介於103億至108億美元，換算較第4季約成長18%，雖然仍維持強勁增長，但減速趨勢已相當明顯。
此外，SanDisk的獲利率也可能接近高峰。公司第3季非公認會計準則調整後毛利率為78.4%，第4季升至84.6%，管理層則預估本季毛利率將介於83%至85%。
截至目前，SanDisk股價約為1,800美元，在週五（18日）大漲11%後，本益比約24倍。這項估值看似合理，但公司近期大部分獲利來自過去兩季，而當時記憶體價格正大幅上漲。
分析指出，若記憶體價格能維持高檔，目前的本益比可能仍相對保守；但如果記憶體價格下跌，公司獲利也可能隨之減少。SanDisk股價過去已展現雙向波動的可能性，目前較6月創下的2,354.39美元高點低約24%。
整體而言，SanDisk納入標普100指數值得關注，但這項調整本身對股價的實質影響可能有限。公司更早之前加入標普500指數的重大事件已於去年11月發生，加上管理層預期營收成長放緩，未來股價走勢仍將取決於記憶體價格及企業獲利表現，而非單純的指數成分股身分。

items.title: 黃仁勳再駁AI末日論 重申技術可控、不會造成人類滅絕
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Refutes AI Doomsday Claims, Reaffirms Technology Is Controllable and Won’t Lead to Human Extinction
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳再次駁斥人工智慧（AI）末日論，表示這項技術對人類並不構成生存威脅。
黃仁勳接受CBS新聞專訪時表示：「無論外界如何描繪，2030年絕不會是世界末日。這絕對是零機率發生的事。」
黃仁勳近日出席多場活動時，一再重申AI可以在安全的情況下受到妥善管理。身為全球主要AI處理器供應商的執行長，他也反對制定新的監管法規。
本月初，Anthropic員工Jacob Coxon因請辭引發了一波AI恐慌潮。他警告指出，打造AI的研究人員「真心認為，AI可能在10年內害死所有人」。
這段專訪預定周日(20日)完整播出。黃仁勳在訪問中主張，AI產業不應放慢發展腳步。
他表示：「無論其他人怎麼做，我們都應該盡可能加快腳步。但我們絕對不會，也不應該在產品準備妥當前推出，更不能交付不安全的產品。」
近幾周，業界對AI發展速度過快的疑慮持續升溫，多名資深人士呼籲建立安全防護機制，並加強政府監管。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei也認同Coxon的部分擔憂。他受訪時表示，AI產業長期以來未向公眾充分揭露這項技術的潛在風險，而AI能力正以「指數級」速度成長。近期部分測試案例顯示，先進AI智慧體曾出現出乎預期且具破壞性的行為，進一步加深外界疑慮。
不過，川普政府迄今大致未認同這些警告。本周稍早，黃仁勳在洛杉磯發表演說期間接到川普來電，並當場開啟擴音，兩人公開交談約5分鐘。
川普在通話中明確反對當前全球推動AI安全監管的趨勢，直指外界熱議的AI風險毫無根據。黃仁勳則公開支持川普的看法，表示川普「看透了問題的複雜性」。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang once again dismissed AI doomsday narratives, stating that the technology does not pose an existential threat to humanity.
In an interview with CBS News, Huang said, "No matter how the outside world paints it, 2030 will not be the end of the world. The probability of that happening is absolutely zero."

Huang has repeatedly emphasized at recent events that AI can be safely managed. As the chief executive of a leading global AI‑processor supplier, he also opposes the introduction of new regulatory rules.
Earlier this month, Anthropic employee Jacob Coxon resigned, sparking a wave of AI‑related panic. He warned that researchers building AI "genuinely believe AI could kill everyone within ten years."
The full interview is scheduled to air on Sunday the 20th. In the interview, Huang argued that the AI industry should not slow its development pace.
He said, "Regardless of what others do, we should accelerate as much as possible. But we will never, and should never, launch products before they are ready, nor deliver unsafe products."
In recent weeks, industry concerns about the rapid pace of AI development have intensified, with several senior figures calling for safety mechanisms and stronger government oversight.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei echoed some of Coxon’s worries, noting in an interview that the AI sector has long failed to fully disclose the technology’s potential risks to the public, and that AI capabilities are growing at an "exponential" rate. Recent test cases have shown advanced AI agents exhibiting unexpected and destructive behavior, further deepening external concerns.

However, the Trump administration has so far largely dismissed these warnings. Earlier this week, while delivering a speech in Los Angeles, Huang received a call from former President Trump, put the call on speakerphone, and the two spoke publicly for about five minutes.

During the call, Trump explicitly opposed the current global push for AI safety regulation, stating that the widely discussed AI risks are baseless. Huang publicly supported Trump’s view, saying Trump "has seen through the complexity of the issue."

items.title: AI資本支出90%增量來自記憶體！瑞銀上修預測、亞洲記憶體鏈可望受惠
items.title_en: AI Capital Spending Surge 90% Driven by Memory: UBS Raises Forecast, Asian Memory Chain Set to Benefit
paras: 瑞銀（UBS）大幅上修人工智慧（AI）資本支出預測，認為記憶體成本急遽攀升，正成為推動新一波AI投資擴張的核心因素，也使AI投資週期的產業受益結構與經濟效應出現變化。
根據瑞銀最新估算，2026年全球AI資本支出總額將達9,980億美元，較2025年的5,060億美元幾乎翻倍；2027年更將進一步升至1.447兆美元。
然而，瑞銀此次大幅上修預測，主要反映記憶體價格快速上漲，而非AI基礎設施投資規模全面擴大。
記憶體正逐漸成為AI資本支出成長的主要來源。瑞銀預估，全球記憶體支出將從2025年的710億美元，大幅增至2026年的3,670億美元，並於2027年進一步攀升至9,230億美元。
相較之下，其他AI相關支出走勢則有所不同。瑞銀預計，非記憶體類AI資本支出在2026年約為6,310億美元，但2027年將回落至5,250億美元。
從支出結構來看，記憶體在AI資本支出中的占比將出現大幅變化。2025年，記憶體支出約占AI資本支出總額的14%；瑞銀預估，這一比例2026年將升至37%，2027年更可能攀升至64%。
瑞銀估算，2026年AI資本支出的年增額中，約60%來自記憶體成本上升。到了2027年，記憶體支出的增量甚至超過AI資本支出的整體淨增幅，因為其他組件的支出同期出現下滑。
整體而言，瑞銀預估，2025年至2027年間，AI資本支出將增加近1兆美元，其中約90%的增量來自記憶體支出攀升。
這項估算顯示，AI投資週期的經濟驅動因素正在轉變，支出擴張不再單純反映基礎設施規模擴大，也與支撐高效能運算系統所需關鍵零組件的成本上升密切相關。
值得注意的是，瑞銀表示，若AI資本支出的成長主要由記憶體價格上漲所推動，對美國實質GDP的帶動效果將相對有限。
在這種情況下，新增支出較大程度上將體現為AI基礎設施投資者與記憶體生產商之間的利潤分配變化，而非美國境內實際產出同步增加。
由於全球主要記憶體製造商集中於亞洲，相關支出與利潤流向可能對亞洲記憶體產業及相關經濟體的GDP帶來更直接的正面影響。
根據瑞銀分析，隨著AI投資週期持續推進，亞洲記憶體產業鏈的受益程度或將超出先前市場預期。
paras_en: UBS has sharply raised its forecast for artificial intelligence (AI) capital spending, seeing soaring memory costs as the core driver of a new wave of AI investment expansion, which also alters the industry benefit structure and economic impact of the AI investment cycle.
According to UBS’s latest estimate, global AI capital spending will reach $998 billion in 2026, almost doubling the $506 billion projected for 2025, and will climb further to $1.447 trillion in 2027.
However, UBS’s substantial upward revision mainly reflects the rapid rise in memory prices rather than a blanket expansion of AI infrastructure investment size.

Memory is becoming the primary source of AI capital spending growth. UBS projects global memory spending to jump from $71 billion in 2025 to $367 billion in 2026 and rise further to $923 billion in 2027.
In contrast, other AI‑related expenditures follow a different trajectory. UBS expects non‑memory AI capital spending to be about $631 billion in 2026 but to fall back to $525 billion in 2027.

From a spending‑structure perspective, memory’s share of AI capital spending will shift dramatically. In 2025, memory accounts for roughly 14% of total AI spending; UBS forecasts this to rise to 37% in 2026 and potentially to 64% in 2027.

UBS estimates that about 60% of the year‑on‑year increase in AI capital spending in 2026 will stem from higher memory costs. By 2027, the incremental memory spend will even exceed the overall net growth in AI capital spending as spending on other components declines.
Overall, UBS projects that AI capital spending will grow by nearly $1 trillion from 2025 to 2027, with roughly 90% of that increase coming from rising memory expenditures.

This estimate shows that the economic drivers of the AI investment cycle are shifting; spending expansion is no longer solely a reflection of larger infrastructure scale but is closely tied to rising costs of key components needed for high‑performance computing systems.
UBS notes that if AI capital spending growth is mainly driven by memory price hikes, the boost to U.S. real GDP will be relatively limited.

In such a scenario, the bulk of the new spending will manifest as a profit‑sharing shift between AI infrastructure investors and memory manufacturers rather than a synchronous rise in domestic U.S. output.

Because the world’s major memory manufacturers are concentrated in Asia, the related spending and profit flows are likely to have a more direct positive impact on the Asian memory industry and the GDP of associated economies.
UBS analysis suggests that as the AI investment cycle continues, the Asian memory supply chain could benefit more than previously expected.

items.title: 「AI股神」又出手了？SanDisk暴漲11%、記憶體和晶片股「短期選擇權」爆巨量
paras: 美國人工智慧（AI）與半導體類股近期出現大額短期期權交易，市場焦點再度轉向曾因高槓桿押注AI股票而聲名大噪的「AI股神」、避險基金Situational Awareness經理人Leopold Aschenbrenner。
週五（18日），約有9,600萬美元的看漲期權權利金集中流入SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、英特爾(INTC-US) 及邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 等4檔AI概念股。其中，SanDisk股價盤中一度大漲11%。
《CNBC》主持人Jim Cramer在社群平台X發文表示，這波交易讓他聯想到Aschenbrenner重新進場。
Aschenbrenner是OpenAI前核心研究員，也是AI主題避險基金Situational Awareness創辦人，過去曾因運用高槓桿大舉買進半導體與AI企業的短期看漲期權而受到市場關注。

近億美元看漲期權集中押注4檔AI股

根據ZeroHedge彙整的盤中交易數據，這批將於10月2日到期的看漲期權，交易內容如下：

美光：履約價1,000美元，約1萬張合約，權利金約4,400萬美元。
SanDisk：履約價1,600美元，約4,200張合約，權利金約4,100萬美元。
英特爾：履約價115美元，約2萬張合約，權利金約730萬美元。
邁威爾科技：履約價250美元，約3,500張合約，權利金約385萬美元。


交易發生時，SanDisk股價已高於期權履約價；美光股價則接近履約價，英特爾與邁威爾科技的履約價則略高於當時股價。
由於上述期權距離到期日僅剩約兩週，時間價值衰減及Gamma敏感度均相當高，標的股價若未能迅速朝有利方向移動，期權價值可能大幅縮水。
Cramer指出，這批期權的到期日落在美光公布第4季財報之後，而該財報受到整個記憶體產業關注。他早在8月便對記憶體類股抱持樂觀看法，認為AI資料中心需求及供應紀律，正改變記憶體產業過去景氣循環的運作模式。

交易標的與手法引發市場聯想

目前美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的申報文件尚未揭露這批期權的買家身分，但市場之所以猜測Aschenbrenner重新進場，主要是因為交易標的與其過去的投資布局高度重疊。
Situational Awareness在6月底提交的監管文件顯示，SanDisk與美光當時分別約占基金持倉57億美元及56億美元，是該基金最大的兩項投資。此次近億美元的期權交易，也集中在這兩檔股票上。
此外，這批交易採用大額、短天期看漲期權的方式，也與Aschenbrenner過去的操作風格相近。其基金過去曾以高槓桿押注AI市場動能，槓桿率一度達400%。透過大量買進短期看漲期權，可能促使做市商進行Gamma避險交易，進而推升相關股票價格。
交易時間點也與近期市場觀察相互呼應。《金融時報》9月11日報導，Aschenbrenner已透過彈性期權（Flex Options），重新建立超微半導體(AMD-US) 、英特爾、SK海力士(SKHY-US) 、SanDisk及CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 等標的的部位。
野村證券策略師Charlie McElligott當時觀察到，AI及半導體相關標的在數日內累計出現約3.15億美元的期權權利金交易，涉及約11億美元的Delta曝險。
他也指出，半導體ETF未來3個月的看漲期權偏斜度已升至歷史高位。

改用全額支付期權　但押注AI動能的策略未變

Aschenbrenner的基金今年7月遭遇重大損失。在AI類股回檔期間，Situational Awareness基金淨值暴跌67%，並將大部分持倉出售給Citadel。
《金融時報》當時將這起事件列為避險基金史上最大單筆虧損之一，但該基金當年仍錄得約80%的正報酬。
Aschenbrenner在7月底致投資人的信中表示，未來將「另謀再戰之日」，並承諾日後的公開市場投資將採取「全額支付」方式管理。
與先前透過總收益互換（TRS）取得槓桿的做法不同，市場認為Aschenbrenner這次改用全額支付期權。這類交易的最大損失通常限於已支付的權利金，理論上不會面臨追繳保證金或因槓桿而遭到強制平倉的風險。
這項調整可能與基金在崩盤後面臨的融資限制有關。摩根大通已終止與該基金的借貸關係，美國證券交易委員會也向曾為基金提供融資的銀行索取相關資訊，先前合作的經紀商則遭到美國司法部調查。
據《金融時報》報導，Aschenbrenner後續轉向專注科技產業的經紀商Clear Street，重新建立合作關係。
不過， McElligott指出，近期交易仍呈現股價與波動率同步上升的特徵，與7月市場崩跌前的情況相似。這代表交易仍可能集中押注流動性相對有限、具市場動能的股票，試圖透過期權交易帶動股價進一步上漲。
若市場動能反轉，短天期期權的權利金可能迅速歸零，但投資人無法再透過調整槓桿來緩衝損失。
Situational Awareness第3季的13F持股報告預計於11月中旬提交，屆時市場才能透過監管文件確認這批期權交易的實際買家身分。

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro開賣！分析師挺蘋果：換機周期優於預期 股價有13%上漲空間
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Goes on Sale! Analysts Back Apple: Upgrade Cycle Better Than Expected, Stock Has About 13% Upside
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)最新一波iPhone產品採取全高階機款策略，這項做法雖然具有風險，但Evercore ISI分析師認為，這項策略最終將有利於蘋果營收與股價表現。
Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani周五(18日)將蘋果目標價從365美元提升至380美元，較蘋果周四收盤價每股337美元還有約13%的上漲空間。蘋果周五終場下跌0.7%，收在每股334.64美元。
Evercore在完成對約4000名消費者的年度iPhone購買意願調查後，認為iPhone換機周期可能優於預期，因而做出最新預測。
Daryanani寫道：「需求似乎略優於去年，這可能讓iPhone在強勁的升級周期後，迎來另一波成長。」他給予蘋果「優於大盤」的評等。

iPhone 18 Pro先上市 標準版明春推出

iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max在上周的蘋果發表會首次亮相，本周五正式在門市與線上通路開賣。
蘋果今年作風與以往不同，iPhone 18系列只先推出高階Pro機型，而華爾街預期，蘋果將在明年春季推出iPhone 18標準款。以往的蘋果會在同一時間推出新iPhone的四款機型。
高價手機如果能熱賣，將有利於蘋果營收與利潤率，但這項策略也存在風險。iPhone 18 Pro系列售價較前代高出100美元，雖然是為了因應持續的記憶體成本危機才調漲價格，這可能對市場需求造成壓力。

電信商提高優惠 抵銷蘋果漲價壓力

美銀證券(BofA Securities)分析師Wamsi Mohan周四在報告中指出，美國無線電信商已提高購買iPhone的優惠幅度，此舉「大致抵銷了蘋果今年的漲價」。他給予蘋果「買進」評等，目標價370美元。
其他分析師同樣看好iPhone 18 Pro銷售。摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師Erik Woodring周三在報告中指出，iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max的交貨等待時間，也就是消費者下單至收到產品所需的時間，顯示這兩款手機的「潛在需求更健康」。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is launching its latest wave of iPhone products with an all‑premium‑model strategy. While this approach carries risk, Evercore ISI analyst believes it will ultimately benefit Apple’s revenue and stock performance.

Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani raised Apple’s target price on Friday (the 18th) from $365 to $380, implying roughly a 13% upside from Apple’s Thursday close of $337 per share. Apple closed Friday down 0.7% at $334.64 per share.
After completing its annual iPhone purchase‑intent survey of about 4,000 consumers, Evercore sees the iPhone upgrade cycle potentially outpacing expectations, prompting its latest forecast.

Daryanani wrote, “Demand appears slightly stronger than last year, which could give the iPhone another growth wave after a robust upgrade cycle.” He assigned Apple an “out‑perform” rating relative to the broader market.

The iPhone 18 Pro launches first, with the standard model slated for next spring. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max debuted at Apple’s event last week and went on sale in stores and online on Friday.

Apple’s approach this year differs from the past: the iPhone 18 series is being introduced with only the high‑end Pro models, while Wall Street expects the standard iPhone 18 to arrive in spring next year. Historically, Apple released all four new iPhone models simultaneously.

If the high‑priced phones sell well, they will boost Apple’s revenue and profit margins, but the strategy also carries risk. The iPhone 18 Pro series is priced about $100 higher than its predecessor, a hike driven by ongoing memory‑cost pressures that could weigh on demand.

Bank of America Securities analyst Wamsi Mohan noted on Thursday that U.S. wireless carriers have increased iPhone purchase incentives, a move that “largely offsets Apple’s price hikes this year.” He gave Apple a “Buy” rating with a $370 target price.

Other analysts are similarly optimistic about iPhone 18 Pro sales. Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring said on Wednesday that the delivery wait times for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max—i.e., the time from order to receipt—indicate “healthier underlying demand” for the two models.

items.title: 北韓攻擊無人機生產工廠內部畫面首次公開 產品擺滿整個車間
items.title_en: North Korea Releases First Interior Footage of Drone Production Facility, Products Fill Entire Workshop
paras: 北韓勞動黨總書記、國務委員長金正恩16日至18日視察國防工業部門工作，了解軍工企業生產情況。
據《朝中社》報導，金正恩說，建設強大炮兵武力是遏制戰爭和執行戰爭的基本核心。北韓近期在國防力量現代化方面取得的成就，意味著武裝力量的組成、手段以及戰爭應對計畫發生重大變化。
金正恩就軍工企業生產及管理運營提出政策任務，要求繼續加快擴大產能和技術工序現代化，提高攻擊及防禦戰鬥武器系統的人工智慧化水準，進一步提升火炮武器裝甲化、自動化，改善生產條件和環境。
根據《朝中社》刊發的照片，北韓公開了正在生產的大口徑火箭炮和多種類型無人機的生產工廠，部分無人機型號的照片打碼。
北韓還首次展示攻擊無人機的生產車間，照片中出現了幾十架已經製造完工的無人機。
這些無人機曾在北韓多次訓練或火力演示中出現，包括9月12日各級聯合部隊遠程火炮及飛彈部隊進行協同火力打擊訓練。
當天５個火炮及飛彈聯合部隊人員參加訓練，動用各種攻擊無人機、大口徑熱壓火箭炮、戰術彈道飛彈等新型戰鬥系統。
paras_en: North Korean Workers' Party General Secretary and State Chairman Kim Jong Un inspected the defense industry from the 16th to the 18th, reviewing the production status of military‑industrial enterprises.

According to the Korean Central News Agency, Kim said that building a powerful artillery force is the core of deterring and conducting war. The recent achievements in modernising the country’s defence capabilities signify major changes in the composition, means and war‑response plans of its armed forces.

Kim set policy tasks for the production and management of military‑industrial firms, urging a continued acceleration of capacity expansion and modernisation of technical processes, raising the AI level of offensive and defensive weapon systems, further armouring and automating artillery, and improving production conditions and environment.
Photos released by KCNA show North Korea’s factories producing large‑calibre rocket launchers and various types of drones, with some drone model images blurred.
North Korea also unveiled, for the first time, the production workshop for attack drones, showing dozens of completed drones in the pictures.

These drones have appeared in multiple North Korean training exercises and firepower demonstrations, including a coordinated long‑range artillery and missile strike drill by joint forces on September 12.

On that day, personnel from five artillery and missile joint units participated, employing various attack drones, large‑calibre thermobaric rocket launchers, tactical ballistic missiles and other new combat systems.

items.title: AI四巨頭遭起訴！Anthropic「AI放緩論」涉非法商業合謀、違反美國反壟斷法？
items.title_en: Four AI Giants Sued! Anthropic's "AI Slowdown Theory" Involved in Illegal Commercial Conspiracy, Violating US Antitrust Law?
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業的監管爭議正從政策討論延伸至法律層面。據報，4名原告近日在加州聯邦法院提起民事訴訟，指控Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI及Google(GOOGL-US) 涉嫌違反美國反壟斷法，透過公開協調放緩AI發展速度，構成非法商業合謀。
根據《POLITICO》報導，這起訴訟的導火線，是Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）本月稍早發表的一篇文章。
他在文中呼籲AI產業「協調行動」，以「控制AI尖端技術的發展步調」。這項主張隨後獲得xAI負責人馬斯克、OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及Google DeepMind共同創辦人哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）公開附議。
原告認為，相關公開表態已構成競爭對手之間的非法商業協議。案件若進入實質審理階段，可能牽動AI產業的競爭格局及監管方向。
這起訴訟是在加州北區聯邦地方法院提出。原告代理律師之一Nick Rowley在聲明中表示，提告目的是防止「全球最具影響力的營利科技公司之間，基於自身利益達成的私下協議」，導致AI「迅速脫離人類控制」。
Rowley指出，面對核戰爭等可能威脅人類存續的風險，人類應獲得明確且可靠的保障；相關法律規範則應由政府透過透明、合法且對公眾負責的程序建立。
原告的法律主張在於，即使相關表態是以公共安全為出發點，但阿莫戴的公開倡議，以及其他AI產業領袖的回應，可能構成競爭對手就商業行為達成協議，進而觸及美國反壟斷法規範。
這起訴訟的背景，是AI安全議題持續引發討論。近期包括現任及前任AI研究人員均發出警告，認為如果缺乏充分的安全防護措施，AI技術持續發展可能對人類生存構成重大威脅。
相關產業領袖提出放緩AI尖端技術發展的主張，正是在這一背景下出現。
不過，這起訴訟將原本聚焦於AI安全的討論，轉化為反壟斷法律爭議。原告並非否定AI可能帶來的安全風險，而是主張，無論企業出於何種動機，競爭對手之間的協調行為都不應免於法律監督。
原告並在訴狀中強調，涉及AI發展速度及安全規範的決策，應透過政府透明的制度與程序推動，而不應由企業私下協調主導。
4名原告的背景各不相同。其中，律師Cheyenne Hunt過去曾參與揭露前加州聯邦眾議員Eric Swalwell及前緬因州參議員候選人Graham Platner涉及性行為不當的指控。
另外兩名原告為佛羅里達州律師Charles Buist及Nick Spetsas，第4名原告則是加州居民Christine Bullock。
訴訟文件顯示，原告有意將案件擴大為集體訴訟，代表所有受到相關企業放緩AI發展決策影響的群體。若此一訴求獲准，案件涉及的潛在索賠範圍可能擴大。
paras_en: Regulatory disputes in the AI industry are moving from policy discussions to the legal arena. According to reports, four plaintiffs recently filed a civil lawsuit in a federal court in California, accusing Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and Google (GOOGL-US) of violating US antitrust law by publicly coordinating to slow the pace of AI development, constituting illegal commercial collusion.
According to POLITICO, the spark for the lawsuit was an article published earlier this month by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.

In the piece he called for the AI industry to "coordinate actions" to "control the pace of development of cutting‑edge AI technology." The proposal was subsequently publicly endorsed by xAI head Elon Musk, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and DeepMind co‑founder Demis Hassabis.

The plaintiffs argue that the public statements amount to an illegal commercial agreement among competitors. If the case proceeds to trial, it could affect the competitive landscape and regulatory direction of the AI sector.

The suit was filed in the Northern District of California federal court. One of the plaintiffs' attorneys, Nick Rowley, said in a statement that the purpose of the filing is to prevent "private agreements between the world’s most influential for‑profit tech companies, based on their own interests," that could cause AI to "rapidly get out of human control."

Rowley noted that faced with existential risks such as nuclear war, humanity must have clear and reliable safeguards; related legal rules should be established by the government through transparent, lawful, and publicly accountable procedures.

The plaintiffs’ legal claim is that even if the statements are framed as public‑safety concerns, Amodei’s public advocacy and the responses of other AI leaders may constitute an agreement among competitors on business conduct, thereby violating US antitrust statutes.

The lawsuit comes against a backdrop of ongoing debate over AI safety. Recently, both current and former AI researchers have warned that without adequate safety measures, continued AI development could pose a major threat to human survival.
Industry leaders’ calls to slow the development of cutting‑edge AI technologies have emerged in this context.

However, the lawsuit reframes the discussion that was originally focused on AI safety into an antitrust dispute. The plaintiffs do not deny the potential safety risks of AI, but argue that regardless of corporate motives, coordinated behavior among competitors should not be exempt from legal oversight.
The complaint emphasizes that decisions about AI development speed and safety standards should be driven through transparent government processes, not by private corporate coordination.

The four plaintiffs have diverse backgrounds. Among them, attorney Cheyenne Hunt previously helped expose allegations of sexual misconduct involving former California federal Representative Eric Swalwell and former Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner.
The other two plaintiffs are Florida attorneys Charles Buist and Nick Spetsas, and the fourth plaintiff is California resident Christine Bullock.

Court documents show the plaintiffs intend to expand the case into a class action representing all groups affected by the companies’ decisions to slow AI development. If that request is granted, the potential scope of claims could broaden significantly.

items.title: 伊朗向美方提出停戰條件 等待川普政府回應
items.title_en: Iran Presents Ceasefire Conditions to the U.S., Awaits Trump Administration’s Response
paras: 伊朗周六（19日）表示，伊朗最高國家安全委員會已通過卡達向美國提交結束戰爭的條件，目前正在等待川普政府回應。
伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書穆赫辛·雷扎伊表示：「我方正與調解方卡達保持聯繫，卡達已將我方結束戰爭的條件轉交給華府，我方正在等待川普政府回應。」
不過，他同時警告，如果美國政府不接受這些條件，伊朗已經做好迎接「一場決定性戰爭」的準備。
據雷扎伊概述，伊方提出的條件主要包括：美國結束所有針對伊朗的戰事，解凍被凍結的伊朗資產，並結束海上封鎖。
雷扎伊在當天接受採訪時表示：「美國退出諒解備忘錄後，伊朗已經認識到有必要調整對美國的戰略。」
雷扎伊沒有排除美國再次對伊朗發動襲擊的可能性。他表示，根據伊朗方面的軍事評估，這種可能性非常高，但他強調伊朗已經做好準備。
他批評美國和以色列在過去六個月衝突中的戰略評估存在偏差，並聲稱這場衝突最終是由以色列總理尼坦雅胡挑起。
paras_en: Iran said on Saturday (the 19th) that its Supreme National Security Council has approved conditions submitted by Qatar to the United States for ending the war, and it is now waiting for a response from the Trump administration.

Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei said, "We are in contact with the mediator, Qatar, which has forwarded our conditions for ending the war to Washington, and we are awaiting a response from the Trump administration."
However, he also warned that if the U.S. government does not accept these conditions, Iran is prepared for "a decisive war."

According to Rezaei’s outline, Iran’s proposed conditions mainly include: the United States ending all hostilities against Iran, unfreezing Iranian assets that have been frozen, and ending the maritime blockade.
In an interview that day Rezaei said, "After the United States withdrew from the memorandum of understanding, Iran recognized the need to adjust its strategy toward the United States."
Rezaei did not rule out the possibility of another U.S. attack on Iran. He said that, based on Iran’s military assessment, that likelihood is very high, but he stressed that Iran is ready for it.
He criticized the strategic assessments of the United States and Israel during the past six months of conflict, claiming the war was ultimately provoked by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: 科技巨頭尋找台積電替代方案！Piper Sandler：英特爾14A獲亞馬遜、蘋果、Google等公司評估
items.title_en: Tech Giants Seek TSMC Alternatives! Piper Sandler: Intel's 14A Under Evaluation by Amazon, Apple, Google and Others
paras: 儘管英特爾(INTC-US) 下一代14A製程目前尚未確定主要客戶，但根據Piper Sandler最新發布的投資報告，隨著業界積極尋找台積電(2330-TW) 以外的可行替代方案，科技業各大企業均已開始評估這項製程。
根據《Wccftech》報導，Piper Sandler指出，在多項宏觀與微觀因素交互影響下，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、蘋果（Apple）、超微半導體(AMD-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 、特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 及高通(QCOM-US) 都在評估這項下一代製程。
Piper Sandler在報告中對英特爾14A製程抱持相對正面的看法，並指出其技術數據的改善幅度優於預期。
根據相關進展，14A製程的缺陷密度（D0）已於2026年6月降至0.5。英特爾的目標是在2027年第一季前，進一步將D0降至0.1至0.2。
缺陷密度是指每單位矽晶圓面積中，平均檢測到的微小瑕疵或缺陷數量。當晶片製程逐漸接近商業化階段，缺陷密度通常會明顯下降，並帶動晶片良率提升。
英特爾財務長David Zinsner近日也指出，14A製程的改善速度至少是自2012年22奈米製程時代以來最快的一次。
在台積電產能至少要到2028年以前都可能持續吃緊的情況下，半導體業者正積極尋找替代方案，以消化未能及時滿足的訂單需求。
目前，可供選擇的主要對象包括三星電子(005930KS) 與英特爾。
此外，川普政府持續施壓、要求晶片製造業者將產能移回美國，也讓英特爾成為潛在的替代選項之一。不過，這仍取決於14A製程能否達到市場預期。
英特爾8月透過發行新股籌集約150億美元資金，之後又將規模提高至200億美元。儘管公司當時並未明確說明這筆新資金的具體用途，但表示，此次發行旨在協助英特爾掌握未來成長機會，同時維持穩健的資產負債表及投資級信用評等。
不過，英特爾執行長陳立武（Lip-Bu Tan）已多次表示，只有在14A這項最尖端製程取得確定訂單、鎖定主要客戶後，才會批准晶圓代工業務大幅擴張。
這也成為目前觀察14A製程商業化可行性最明確的線索之一。尤其英特爾目前已持有約300億美元現金，似乎沒有必要為一般性用途額外籌資。
此外，隨著英特爾第62座晶圓廠（Fab 62）的廠房主體接近完工，公司預計還需要約100億美元設備建置資金，才能啟用14A製程的新產能，每月約可生產2萬片晶圓。因此，英特爾近期的籌資規模，足以支應即將到來的資本支出需求。
英特爾14A屬於1.4奈米級製程，主要技術特色包括：

PowerDirect背面供電技術： 將電力傳輸線路全面移至矽晶圓背面，釋放正面佈線空間供資料訊號使用，藉此降低電阻並提高電晶體密度。
RibbonFET 2電晶體與第二代環繞式閘極（GAA）架構： 強化對微型電晶體的靜電控制能力，提升驅動電流，同時將功率洩漏降至最低。


英特爾本週再次確認，預計於2027年第二季啟動14A製程的風險試產，並在2028年第一季進入量產階段。
paras_en: Despite Intel (INTC-US) not yet confirming its main customers for the next‑generation 14A process, Piper Sandler’s latest investment report says that as the industry actively looks for viable alternatives to TSMC (2330‑TW), major tech firms have begun evaluating the node.

According to Wccftech, Piper Sandler notes that, amid a mix of macro and micro factors, Amazon (AMZN‑US), Apple, AMD (AMD‑US), Google (GOOGL‑US), Tesla (TSLA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) are all assessing the next‑gen process.
Piper Sandler takes a relatively positive view of Intel’s 14A process in its report, pointing out that the improvement in its technical metrics exceeds expectations.
Based on recent progress, the defect density (D0) of the 14A process fell to 0.5 in June 2026. Intel aims to further reduce D0 to between 0.1 and 0.2 before the first quarter of 2027.

Defect density refers to the average number of tiny flaws detected per unit area of a silicon wafer. As a chip process approaches commercialization, defect density typically drops sharply, driving up wafer yields.
Intel CFO David Zinsner recently said the pace of improvement for 14A is the fastest since the 22‑nm era in 2012.
With TSMC capacity likely to remain tight at least through 2028, semiconductor companies are actively seeking alternatives to absorb unmet order demand.
The primary alternatives currently under consideration are Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and Intel itself.

In addition, pressure from the Trump administration to bring chip manufacturing capacity back to the United States has made Intel a potential substitute, though this still hinges on 14A meeting market expectations.

In August, Intel raised roughly $15 billion through a new share offering, later increasing the target to $20 billion. While the company did not specify the exact use of the proceeds, it said the issuance was intended to help Intel capture future growth opportunities while maintaining a strong balance sheet and investment‑grade credit rating.
However, CEO Lip‑Bu Tan has repeatedly said that only after the 14A node secures firm orders and key customers will Intel approve a major expansion of its foundry business.

This is one of the clearest clues currently available for assessing the commercial viability of 14A. Intel already holds about $30 billion in cash, suggesting there is little need to raise additional funds for generic purposes.

Furthermore, with Fab 62 nearing completion, Intel estimates it will need roughly $10 billion in equipment spending to bring 14A capacity online, which would produce about 20,000 wafers per month. Recent fundraising should comfortably cover this upcoming capex.
Intel’s 14A is a 1.4‑nm class process featuring several key technologies:

PowerDirect backside power delivery moves all power routing to the back of the wafer, freeing front‑side routing for data signals, reducing resistance and increasing transistor density. RibbonFET 2 transistors combined with second‑generation gate‑all‑around (GAA) architecture enhance electrostatic control of tiny transistors, boost drive current and minimize power leakage.

items.title: 中國汽車出口連續三個月突破100萬輛，新能源車為主力
items.title_en: China's Car Exports Surpass 1 Million Units for Three Consecutive Months, Led by New Energy Vehicles
paras:
2026年前8個月中國汽車累計出口715.3萬輛，已超越2025年全年總量。
單月出口連續三個月突破100萬輛，8月新能源車占出口比重超過50%。
出口市場由俄羅斯與中東，逐步擴展至歐洲、拉丁美洲、東南亞及非洲。

2026年09月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 根據中國汽車工業協會(CAAM)數據，中國汽車單月出口量已連續三個月突破100萬輛。2026年前8個月累計出口達715.3萬輛，已超越2025年全年總量，成長主要來自新能源車、自主品牌及出口市場多元化。
新能源車已成為中國汽車出口的主要動能。2026年8月，新能源車占汽車出口比重超過50%，代表出口結構正式從燃油車為主，轉向新能源車占多數。
出口目的地也正在重新分布。中國汽車過去較為依賴俄羅斯與中東市場，但受到當地需求降溫、地緣政治及政策變化影響，中國車企近年加快開拓歐洲、拉丁美洲、東南亞及非洲。目前主要出口目的地包括俄羅斯、巴西、英國、澳洲與阿爾及利亞；新能源車出口則以巴西、比利時與英國等市場表現較突出。
不過，中國汽車擴大海外銷售仍面臨關稅限制。歐盟已對中國製造的電動車加徵關稅，美國與加拿大也以高關稅限制中國汽車進口。為降低貿易壁壘影響，部分中國車企開始在歐洲、東南亞及非洲設立生產基地，海外發展模式逐漸由整車出口延伸至當地生產。

paras_en:
In the first eight months of 2026, China’s cumulative car exports reached 7.153 million units, already exceeding the total volume for the entire year of 2025. Monthly exports have topped one million units for three straight months, and in August new‑energy vehicles accounted for more than 50% of the exports. Export destinations have shifted from a reliance on Russia and the Middle East toward Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia and Africa.

(September 20 2026, You Analysis/Industry Data Center) – According to data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM), China’s monthly car export volume has broken the one‑million‑unit mark for three consecutive months. The cumulative export total for the first eight months of 2026 reached 7.153 million units, surpassing the full‑year figure for 2025, with growth driven mainly by new‑energy vehicles, domestic brands and a diversification of export markets.

New‑energy vehicles have become the main engine of China’s car exports. In August 2026, new‑energy cars made up over 50% of the export mix, indicating that the export structure has officially shifted from being fuel‑vehicle‑centric to being dominated by new‑energy models.

Export destinations are also being reshuffled. China’s auto industry previously depended heavily on Russia and the Middle East, but cooling demand, geopolitical tensions and policy changes have prompted Chinese manufacturers in recent years to accelerate entry into Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia and Africa. Current major export markets include Russia, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Australia and Algeria; new‑energy vehicle shipments are especially strong to Brazil, Belgium and the United Kingdom.

However, expanding overseas sales still faces tariff barriers. The European Union has imposed additional duties on Chinese‑made electric vehicles, and the United States and Canada also restrict Chinese car imports with high tariffs. To mitigate the impact of trade barriers, some Chinese automakers are establishing production bases in Europe, Southeast Asia and Africa, gradually shifting the overseas model from fully built‑up exports to local manufacturing.

items.title: 美軍空襲伊朗小學釀逾150死 聯合國調查團：恐涉戰爭罪
items.title_en: U.S. Airstrike on Iranian Primary School Kills Over 150, UN Investigation Team Says May Constitute War Crimes
paras: 一群由聯合國支持的專家表示，有「合理理由」相信美軍在對伊朗的戰事中犯下戰爭罪，並指出兩起空襲事件，其中一次擊中米納卜（Minab）一所小學，造成約150名平民喪生。
伊朗問題獨立事實調查團提交給日內瓦聯合國人權理事會的報告指出，「有合理理由相信，美國發動無差別攻擊，導致平民死傷或民用設施受損，構成戰爭罪」。
該調查團隊向日內瓦人權理事會提交報告，檢視了兩起空襲，其中包括 2 月下旬以戰斧巡弋飛彈攻擊米納卜的沙賈雷塔耶貝小學（Shajareh Tayyebeh Primary School），造成逾 150 人罹難；另一起空襲則在拉梅爾德（Lamerd）一座體育中心及住宅區散布大量鎢彈丸，導致22人喪生。
這個由聯合國最高人權機構委託成立的調查團，也指控伊朗政府犯下「嚴重侵犯人權及危害人類罪」，包括近期暴力鎮壓伊朗示威群眾。
白宮發言人凱利（Anna Kelly）在聲明中表示：「聯合國人權理事會數十年來不斷拋出不負責任的無稽之談，卻未能為人權取得任何成果。」
她說，這場衝突中唯一犯下戰爭罪的是伊朗政權，該政權殺害數千名本國人民、在海外殺害美國人、於荷姆茲海峽實施恐怖行動，並對區域鄰國發動無差別攻擊。
五角大廈先前表示，正對米納卜事件展開調查。五角大廈一名官員上周四表示，調查仍在進行中，國防部不會就外部組織發布的報告置評。
儘管這份長達18頁的報告不具法律約束力，但它進一步擴充了相關證據，未來可能用於在國際法院追究責任。
米納卜小學遭飛彈攻擊，是數十年來美軍行動造成平民傷亡最嚴重的事件。
彭博新聞6月曾報導，調查人員正釐清導致米納卜空襲的多項失誤，包括美國情報系統彼此未能連線，以及未注意到一名美國情報分析師先前提出的示警。該名分析師曾指出，一處前軍事設施如今已改作小學使用。
paras_en: A group of experts supported by the United Nations says there is "reasonable grounds" to believe that the U.S. military has committed war crimes in its war against Iran, citing two air‑strike incidents, one of which hit a primary school in Minab and killed about 150 civilians.

The independent fact‑finding team on Iran submitted a report to the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva stating that "there are reasonable grounds to believe that the United States carried out indiscriminate attacks that caused civilian deaths and injuries or damage to civilian infrastructure, constituting war crimes."

The team’s report to the Geneva Human Rights Council examined two strikes, including a late‑February attack with a Tomahawk cruise missile on Minab’s Shajareh Tayyebeh Primary School, which killed more than 150 people, and another strike that scattered large quantities of tungsten pellets over a sports centre and residential area in Lamerd, killing 22 people.

The investigation, commissioned by the UN’s highest human‑rights body, also accuses the Iranian government of "serious violations of human rights and crimes against humanity," including the recent violent crackdown on protestors in Iran.

White House spokesperson Anna Kelly said in a statement: "For decades the UN Human Rights Council has continuously spewed irresponsible nonsense and has failed to achieve any results for human rights."

She added that the only party committing war crimes in the conflict is the Iranian regime, which has killed thousands of its own citizens, murdered Americans abroad, carried out terrorist actions in the Hormuz Strait, and launched indiscriminate attacks on neighboring countries.

The Pentagon previously said it is investigating the Minab incident. A Pentagon official told reporters last Thursday that the investigation is ongoing and the Department of Defense will not comment on the report issued by an external organization.
Although the 18‑page report is not legally binding, it expands the evidentiary record and could later be used to hold parties accountable before an international court.
The missile strike on Minab’s primary school is the deadliest civilian casualty event caused by U.S. forces in decades.

Bloomberg reported in June that investigators are sorting out multiple mistakes that led to the Minab strike, including a failure of U.S. intelligence systems to communicate with each other and the overlooking of an earlier warning from an American intelligence analyst who had flagged that a former military facility had been converted into a school.

items.title: 胡塞武裝稱對沙烏地首都及關鍵原油設施發動攻擊！石油出口面臨雙重威脅
items.title_en: Houthi Forces Claim Attacks on Saudi Capital and Key Oil Facility, Threatening Oil Exports
paras: 葉門胡塞武裝宣稱，週六（19日）對沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的「敏感目標」及沙烏地阿美（Saudi Aramco）位於延布（Yanbu）的設施發動兩波軍事行動，使用彈道飛彈、巡弋飛彈及無人機，並稱「取得成功」。沙烏地則表示，已攔截胡塞武裝發射的一枚彈道飛彈，並擊退多起襲擊。
根據陸媒《央視》新聞報導，胡塞武裝指出，這兩次行動是為了報復沙烏地持續發動空襲，以及指責葉門攻擊麥加等行為。
該組織表示，沙烏地動用F-15及「颱風」戰鬥機，從海米斯穆謝特（Khamis Mushait）與塔伊夫兩座基地發動空襲，累計達732次，造成平民傷亡及民用基礎設施受損。
胡塞武裝今年9月初重新發動攻勢，行動頻率明顯增加。利雅德過去曾於2017年、2018年及2020年多次遭到胡塞武裝飛彈攻擊，但據報此次是利雅德首次啟動防空警報，顯示當地面臨的威脅出現新的變化。
胡塞武裝此次鎖定的兩處目標，分別涉及沙烏地的首都及能源出口設施。
該組織宣稱，第一次行動以沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的「敏感目標」為目標，第二次行動以沙烏地阿美公司位於延布的設施為目標。聲明稱，兩次行動均「取得成功」，目標區域發生大規模火災。
延布位於紅海沿岸，是當地重要港口城市，設有煉油廠及與沙烏地東西向輸油管道相連的石油出口碼頭。
利雅德哈立德國王國際機場的航空燃油設施，則是沙烏地民用航空運作的重要基礎設施。
不過，沙烏地主導的多國聯軍發言人馬利基表示，沙烏地防空系統已攔截並摧毀一枚胡塞武裝發射的彈道飛彈，並擊退針對巴伊什（Baish）、塔伊夫（Taif）、法拉桑（Farasan）及延布的多起襲擊。
本週三，胡塞武裝亦另宣稱擊落一架沙烏地F-15戰鬥機，並公布疑似飛機殘骸的影像。
胡塞武裝此前已控制紅海港口城市莫卡（Mokha），以及位於曼德海峽南端的丕林島（Perim Island），對沙烏地紅海原油出口通道形成壓力。
另一方面，沙烏地東西向輸油管道先前也曾遭到伊拉克境內發射的無人機攻擊，使該國石油運輸與出口體系接連面臨干擾，能源供應鏈承受的風險進一步升高。
《彭博》指出，伊朗及其盟友接連採取的軍事行動，被認為可能透過削弱沙烏地石油出口能力，加大對美國及全球經濟的衝擊。由於伊朗自身的波斯灣原油出口正受到美國海軍封鎖影響，相關代理武裝是否協同行動，以及其對區域能源市場的影響，也因此受到外界關注。

葉門戰事延續逾十年 沙烏地尋求外部支援

葉門內戰自胡塞武裝2014年攻占首都沙那後延續至今。沙烏地主導的阿拉伯聯軍於2015年介入戰事，支持葉門國際承認政府。這場衝突已造成逾15萬人死亡，數百萬人流離失所，葉門也一度瀕臨大規模饑荒。
近年來，交戰雙方曾維持脆弱的停火局面。期間，沙烏地向葉門政府官員，包括沙那的官員支付薪資；胡塞武裝則在加薩衝突期間，將攻擊目標擴大至以色列及紅海航運。
然而，胡塞武裝9月初重啟攻勢，使這段相對穩定的局面再度受到衝擊。
美國中央司令部司令、海軍上將庫柏（Brad Cooper）週六發布影片聲明表示，儘管伊朗發動攻擊，仍有超過10億桶來自美國盟友的原油成功通過荷姆茲海峽。
不過，庫柏並未說明這項數據的具體計算依據。商業船運追蹤機構通常提出的估算數字較低，部分原因在於多艘船隻關閉應答器或採取規避追蹤的措施，增加了航運數據蒐集的難度。
面對胡塞武裝持續施壓，沙烏地目前已尋求國際支持，但截至目前，相關行動尚未演變成大規模反擊。
paras_en: Yemen's Houthi forces said they launched two waves of military actions on Saturday (the 19th) against a "sensitive target" in Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh and a Saudi Aramco facility in Yanbu, using ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones, and claimed the operations were "successful". Saudi officials said they intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis and repelled multiple attacks.
According to state media CCTV, the Houthis said the two actions were retaliation for Saudi Arabia's ongoing airstrikes and to condemn Yemen's attacks on Mecca and other actions.

The group said Saudi Arabia deployed F‑15s and "Typhoon" fighters from the Khamis Mushait and Taif bases, carrying out a total of 732 airstrikes that caused civilian casualties and damage to civilian infrastructure.

The Houthis resumed an offensive in early September, with the frequency of attacks markedly increasing. Riyadh had previously been hit by Houthi missiles in 2017, 2018 and 2020, but this was reportedly the first time the city sounded an air‑defence alert, indicating a new level of threat.
The two targets the Houthis focused on this time involve Saudi Arabia's capital and its oil‑export infrastructure.

The group said the first operation targeted a "sensitive target" in Riyadh, while the second aimed at Saudi Aramco's facility in Yanbu. The statement claimed both operations were "successful" and sparked large fires in the target areas.
Yanbu, on the Red Sea coast, is an important port city that hosts a refinery and an oil‑export terminal linked to Saudi Arabia's east‑west oil pipeline.
Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport's aviation fuel facilities are a key piece of Saudi civil aviation infrastructure.

However, a spokesperson for the Saudi‑led multinational coalition, Malik, said Saudi air‑defence systems intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis and repelled multiple attacks aimed at Baish, Taif, Farasan and Yanbu.
On Wednesday this week, the Houthis also claimed to have shot down a Saudi F‑15 fighter and released footage they said showed the aircraft's wreckage.

The Houthis have previously taken control of the Red Sea port city of Mokha and Perim Island at the southern end of the Bab al‑Mandeb Strait, putting pressure on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea crude‑oil export route.

Separately, Saudi Arabia's east‑west oil pipeline has previously been hit by drone attacks launched from within Iraq, further disrupting the country's oil transport and export system and raising risks to the energy supply chain.

Bloomberg noted that Iran and its allies' successive military actions could weaken Saudi oil‑export capacity, amplifying the impact on the United States and the global economy. Because Iran's own Persian Gulf crude exports are being blocked by a U.S. naval blockade, observers are watching whether proxy forces are coordinating actions and how this could affect regional energy markets.

The Yemeni civil war has raged for more than a decade, with Saudi Arabia seeking external support. The conflict began after the Houthis seized the capital Sana'a in 2014 and has continued to the present. Saudi‑led Arab forces intervened in 2015 to back the internationally recognised Yemeni government. The war has caused over 150,000 deaths and displaced millions, pushing Yemen to the brink of famine at times.

In recent years, both sides have maintained a fragile cease‑fire. During that period, Saudi Arabia paid salaries to Yemeni government officials, including those in Sana'a, while the Houthis expanded their targets during the Gaza conflict to include Israel and Red Sea shipping.
However, the Houthis' renewed offensive in early September disrupted this relatively stable situation again.

U.S. Central Command commander, Admiral Brad Cooper, released a video on Saturday stating that despite Iran's attacks, more than one billion barrels of crude from U.S. allies have successfully passed through the Hormuz Strait.

Cooper did not explain the methodology behind that figure. Commercial vessel‑tracking firms usually estimate lower volumes, partly because many ships turn off transponders or take measures to avoid tracking, making data collection more difficult.
Facing continued pressure from the Houthis, Saudi Arabia has sought international assistance, but so far no large‑scale retaliation has materialized.

items.title: 巴菲特卸任波克夏董座 留下5個領導哲學：想好訃聞、別死後還想掌權
items.title_en: Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Chairman, Leaves 5 Leadership Philosophies: Think About Your Obituary, Don’t Want to Rule After Death
paras: 想要成為像巴菲特這樣成就非凡的領袖，保持謙遜至關重要。這位「奧馬哈先知」上周卸下了波克夏(A)(BRK.A-US) 董事長的職務，結束了他超過半個世紀打造並經營這家企業集團的生涯。巴菲特表示，他的兒子霍華將接任董事長。
霍華將負責守護波克夏的企業文化與價值觀。巴菲特先前曾表示，這些無形資產「比我們資產負債表上的任何東西都更有價值」。
對於像巴菲特這樣深信組織文化重要性的人而言，這並非新鮮事。多年來，他在投資與領導統御方面持續提供了源源不絕的真知灼見。
去年，在他以執行長身分發給股東的最後一封感恩節信函中，他分享了關於奉獻、誠信，以及他所謂在試圖抑制執行長高薪時卻適得其反的「好意」等美德見解。
其中一個宏觀的核心收穫，便是他呼籲眾人持續學習與成長。
巴菲特寫道：「慎選你心目中的英雄，然後向他們學習。你永遠不會完美，但永遠可以變得更好。」
以下是巴菲特分享的其他五項經營與人生哲學：
保持謙遜
現年96歲的巴菲特向來以務實、不講排場的作風經營波克夏。他曾談到，運氣在自己的人生與事業中扮演重要角色，而這些經歷也不斷加深他的謙遜態度。
巴菲特表示：「要記住，清潔人員和董事長一樣，都是有血有肉的人。」
他也將自己的成就部分歸因於先天條件與幸運。相較於他的姊妹們，他形容她們「擁有同等聰明的頭腦與更好的性格」，儘管她們面臨截然不同的社會前景。
他說：「我1930年出生，身體健康、智力還算不錯，是白人、男性，而且出生在美國。哇！感謝幸運女神眷顧。」
從錯誤中學習
巴菲特表示，儘管自己犯過無數錯誤，但他始終試圖將其轉化為成長的跳板。「從中學到至少一點教訓，然後繼續前進。」
他指出，其中一個失誤是當他發現某家母公司或子公司一位「優秀且忠誠的執行長」出現「罹患失智症、阿茲海默症或其他長期失能疾病」的徵兆時，自己沒有更強勢地介入。
「查理和我曾多次遇到這個問題，卻未能採取行動。這種不作為可能會釀成巨大錯誤，」巴菲特寫道，他所指的是他結交多年、已於2023年逝世的摯友兼事業夥伴查理蒙格。
巴菲特表示，儘管這通常並非易事，但董事會必須密切留意高階主管是否出現此類病徵，執行長本身也需要在其管轄的單位內做到這一點。
「董事們應提高警覺並勇於發聲，這是我唯一的忠告，」這封約莫7頁長的信件中如此寫道。
選對領導人
巴菲特對謙遜的要求，也延伸至波克夏未來領導人的行事方式及追求目標。
他認為，未來100年內，波克夏只需要更換5至6位執行長。在上周五發布的致股東信中，巴菲特再次表達對接任執行長的阿貝爾充滿信心。
巴菲特寫道：「他早已開始負責真正重要的決策，而他的任何決定都未曾讓我產生疑慮。」
波克夏原本是新英格蘭地區的一家紡織公司，巴菲特自1960年代初期開始買進該公司股票。他去年秋天曾表示，波克夏應避免聘用動機不純的高階主管。
巴菲特說：「公司尤其應避開那些一心想在65歲退休、追求炫耀式財富，或企圖建立家族王朝的人。」
思考你的訃聞
巴菲特在信中反覆強調一項觀念：「想要變得更好，永遠不嫌晚。」
他的另一項建議是，先想像自己希望訃聞如何描述一生，再反向思考，「活出一段配得上那篇訃聞的人生」。
由於巴菲特身為全球最著名投資人之一的地位，他向波克夏股東發布第三封年度感恩節信函已然成了一大盛事。他當時表示，未來仍計畫透過年度信件與股東對話，儘管不再以執行長身分。「用英國人的話來說，我要『安靜退場』了。算是吧。」
不要在身後繼續掌權
巴菲特決定轉任名譽董事長，也符合他不應過度延續個人影響力的主張。
在感恩節致股東信中，巴菲特稱讚阿貝爾的能力。阿貝爾比他年輕約30歲，並已於2026年初接任波克夏執行長。
巴菲特表示：「他是一位卓越的經理人、不知疲倦的工作狂，也是一位誠懇的溝通者。」
他同時也提及自己的三個孩子，表示他們具備妥善分配家族龐大財富所需的「成熟度、智慧、精力和直覺」。今年稍早，巴菲特的淨資產已逼近1500億美元。
巴菲特去年曾寫道，在他過世後，他的孩子們將能自由應對稅法政策及其他變數的變化，以持續推動家族的慈善事業。
他說：「歷來試圖死後掌權的人，結果往往不理想，而我從來沒有這樣的念頭。」
paras_en: To become a leader as extraordinary as Warren Buffett, humility is essential. The “Oracle of Omaha” stepped down last week from his role as chairman of Berkshire (A)(BRK.A-US), ending a career of more than half a century building and running the conglomerate. Buffett said his son Howard will succeed him as chairman.
Howard will be responsible for safeguarding Berkshire’s corporate culture and values. Buffett has previously said that these intangible assets “are worth more than anything on our balance sheet.”

For someone like Buffett, who deeply believes in the importance of organizational culture, this is not new. Over the years he has continuously offered a steady stream of insight on investing and leadership.

In his final Thanksgiving letter to shareholders as CEO last year, he shared his thoughts on virtues such as dedication, integrity, and the “good intentions” that backfire when trying to curb excessive CEO pay.
One of the overarching takeaways was his call for everyone to keep learning and growing.
Buffett wrote, “Choose your heroes wisely, then learn from them. You’ll never be perfect, but you can always get better.”
Below are the other five business and life philosophies Buffett shared:
Stay Humble
Now 96, Buffett has always run Berkshire in a pragmatic, no‑frills manner. He has spoken about how luck has played a major role in his life and career, deepening his humility over time.
Buffett said, “Remember, the janitor is just as much a human being as the chairman.”

He also attributes part of his success to innate traits and luck. Compared with his sisters, he described them as “equally smart but with better personalities,” even though they faced very different social prospects.
He said, “I was born in 1930, I’m healthy, reasonably intelligent, white, male, and born in the United States. Wow! Thank you, Lady Luck.”
Learn From Mistakes
Buffett noted that although he has made countless mistakes, he always tries to turn them into stepping stones for growth. “Learn at least one lesson from each, then move on.”
He pointed out that one error was failing to intervene more forcefully when he noticed a “stellar and loyal CEO” showing signs of dementia, Alzheimer’s or other long‑term incapacities.

“Charlie and I have encountered this many times and did nothing. That inaction could lead to a huge mistake,” Buffett wrote, referring to his longtime friend and business partner Charlie Munger, who passed away in 2023.
Buffett said that, while it’s often difficult, boards must closely monitor senior executives for such symptoms, and CEOs themselves need to do the same within their domains.
“Directors should stay alert and speak up—that’s my only advice,” the roughly seven‑page letter said.
Choose the Right Leaders
Buffett’s demand for humility also extends to how Berkshire’s future leaders should act and what they should pursue.
He believes Berkshire will need only five or six CEOs over the next 100 years. In the shareholder letter released last Friday, Buffett again expressed confidence in the incoming CEO, Ajay Babel.
Buffett wrote, “He has already been making the truly important decisions, and I have never doubted any of his choices.”
Berkshire began as a New England textile firm, and Buffett started buying its stock in the early 1960s. He said last fall that Berkshire should avoid hiring senior managers with impure motives.
Buffett said, “The company should especially steer clear of people who only want to retire at 65, chase flashy wealth, or build a family dynasty.”
Think About Your Obituary
Buffett repeatedly emphasized in the letter, “It’s never too late to get better.”
Another piece of advice is to first imagine how you want your obituary to describe your life, then work backward, “live a life worthy of that obituary.”

Because of Buffett’s stature as one of the world’s most famous investors, his third annual Thanksgiving letter to Berkshire shareholders has become a major event. He said he still plans to communicate with shareholders through the annual letter, even though he is no longer CEO. “In British terms, I’m going to ‘quietly exit.’ That’s about it.”
Don’t Keep Power After You’re Gone
Buffett’s decision to become honorary chairman aligns with his belief that he should not extend his personal influence excessively.
In the Thanksgiving letter, Buffett praised Babel’s abilities. Babel is about 30 years younger and took over as Berkshire’s CEO in early 2026.
Buffett said, “He is an outstanding manager, tireless workaholic, and a sincere communicator.”

He also mentioned his three children, saying they possess the “maturity, wisdom, energy and intuition” needed to allocate the family’s vast wealth responsibly. Earlier this year, Buffett’s net worth approached $150 billion.
Buffett wrote last year that after his death his children will be free to adapt to tax‑law changes and other variables, continuing the family’s philanthropic efforts.
He said, “People who try to rule after death usually end poorly, and I’ve never had that thought.”

items.title: 輝達加持的AI新創Nscale申請上市！上半年營收暴增12.5倍仍虧損逾10億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup Nscale Files for IPO! H1 Revenue Surges 12.5‑Fold Yet Losses Exceed $1 Billion
paras: 獲輝達(NVDA-US)投資、專注人工智慧(AI)模型基礎設施的雲端服務商Nscale，周五(18日)已向紐約證券交易所(NYSE)申請上市，股票代號為「NSCL」。
根據Nscale首次公開發行(IPO)說明書，在截至今年6月30日的六個月內期間，營收為1.406億美元，淨虧損達10.2億美元。相比之下，去年同期淨損為3.689億美元，營收僅1040萬美元，代表營收較去年同期暴增1252%。
Nscale並透露，目前為止的剩餘履約義務(RPO)達564億美元。
對手包括亞馬遜、CoreWeave
Nscale的競爭對手包括市場領先的雲端服務商亞馬遜(AMZN-US)，以及CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等被稱為「新雲」(neocloud)的新一代供應商。
自2022年ChatGPT推出以來，OpenAI、Anthropic等AI實驗室對運算能力的需求似乎永無止境。因此，Anthropic與OpenAI都需要大量現金支付算力費用，兩家公司也都計劃上市。
這兩家AI實驗室都已與Nscale達成交易，由Nscale出租輝達圖形處理器(GPU)，供AI模型訓練與運行使用。
本身也是雲端服務商的微軟(MSFT-US)也已與Nscale簽約。Nscale表示，2026年上半年有一家未具名客戶貢獻超過一半營收。
尋求分散客戶、靠收購擴大AI服務
Nscale近來也試圖分散業務來源，目前已開始提供多款AI模型的推理服務。此外，7月還宣布計劃收購協助建構AI模型的新創軟體公司Anyscale。
Nscale上周宣布，曾任OpenAI、Instacart(CART-US)與Meta(META-US)高層的Fidji Simo加入董事會。其他董事會成員還包括Meta前高層Nick Clegg與桑柏格(Sheryl Sandberg)。
### 手握46.1萬顆GPU合約　但負債逾80億美元
截至8月31日，Nscale擁有2.5萬顆啟用中的GPU，若加入已啟用或已簽約的GPU，總數達46.1萬顆。公司目前擁有五座已啟用、12座已簽約的資料中心據點。
Nscale表示目前已掌握相當於10GW的運算能力，負債則超過80億美元，這個金額還沒把與AI伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)的融資計畫算進來。
Nscale總部位於倫敦，截至8月31日擁有逾1000名全職員工。該公司於2024年結束神秘模式，從加密貨幣挖礦公司Arkon Energy分拆成立，投資人包括Blue Owl、戴爾、輝達、Fidelity與Point72。
Nscale今年3月表示，在其中一輪募資中，投資人對公司的估值達146億美元。
根據Nscale向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的文件，輝達同意為Nscale在德州一項資料中心租賃協議下最高8.6億美元的義務提供擔保。
paras_en: Nscale, a cloud‑service provider focused on AI model infrastructure and backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US), filed on Friday (the 18th) for a listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker "NSCL".

According to Nscale’s prospectus, revenue for the six‑month period ending June 30 this year was $140.6 million, while net loss reached $1.02 billion. By contrast, the same period last year saw a net loss of $368.9 million and revenue of only $10.4 million, meaning revenue jumped 1,252% year‑over‑year.
Nscale disclosed that its remaining performance obligations (RPO) to date total $56.4 billion.
Competitors include Amazon and CoreWeave.
Nscale’s rivals comprise market‑leading cloud provider Amazon (AMZN‑US) as well as next‑generation “neocloud” suppliers such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US).

Since the launch of ChatGPT in 2022, AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have shown seemingly endless demand for compute power. Consequently, both Anthropic and OpenAI need massive cash to pay for compute and are planning IPOs themselves.
Both AI labs have struck deals with Nscale, which rents Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) to them for training and running AI models.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US), also a cloud provider, has signed a contract with Nscale. Nscale said an unnamed customer contributed more than half of its revenue in the first half of 2026.
Seeking to diversify its customer base and grow AI services through acquisitions

Nscale has recently been trying to diversify its revenue sources; it has begun offering inference services for a variety of AI models and announced in July a plan to acquire the AI‑model‑building startup Anyscale.

Last week Nscale announced that Fidji Simo, a former senior executive at OpenAI, Instacart (CART‑US) and Meta (META‑US), has joined its board. Other board members include former Meta executive Nick Clegg and Sheryl Sandberg.
### Holding contracts for 461,000 GPUs but debt exceeds $8 billion

As of August 31, Nscale operated 25,000 active GPUs; counting GPUs already activated or under contract brings the total to 461,000. The company currently runs five active data‑center sites and has contracts for twelve additional sites.
Nscale says it now controls roughly 10 GW of compute capacity, while its debt tops $8 billion, not including financing arrangements with AI‑server maker Dell (DELL‑US).

Nscale is headquartered in London and had more than 1,000 full‑time employees as of August 31. The company emerged from “stealth mode” in 2024, spinning out of cryptocurrency miner Arkon Energy, with investors such as Blue Owl, Dell, Nvidia, Fidelity and Point72.
In March this year Nscale disclosed that a financing round valued the company at $14.6 billion.
SEC filings show that Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $860 million for Nscale’s Texas data‑center lease obligations.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元維持逾7周高點 Fed立場偏鷹
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。
今年以來，日本當局已投入超過15兆日元(約957億美元)支撐日元匯率。
日元周五一度跌至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後收復部分跌幅，最高回升至155.88。本周創下2025年10月以來最差單周表現。
